headline: Tencent's hy4-flash still reigns at 42.0% while Qwen4-Max vaults 33 places to a 1.0% all-time high
summary: Qwen4-Max leapt 33 places to #13 and set a new all-time token share record at 1.0%. Tencent's provider share sits at 44.7%, up 35.3 points over seven days, and the top two providers hold 68.2% between them.
highlights: tencent/hy4-flash-20261116 remains the undisputed #1 at 42.0% of tokens, and Tencent as a provider holds 44.7%.
Qwen4-Max is the day's headline mover, rocketing from far down the board to #13 with 1.0% share, and it's a fresh record rather than a continuing streak.
DeepSeek and Tencent together hold 68.2%, the top-two concentration figure for today.
Google's gemini-4-neon-20261118 debuted at #40 with 0.2% of tokens.
qwen/qwen3.6-35b-a3b-20260415 dropped out of the rankings from #51, last seen at 0.1% share.
